results.title: GENERAL RAILWAY — GENERAL_RAILWAY_ANSWER, zero provider calls
results.text: RAC aur WL mein kya difference hai?
results.reply:
RAC aur WL ka basic difference yeh hai:

**RAC (Reservation Against Cancellation):**
- Ticket **confirm** hoti hai, lekin **seat share** karni padti hai — sleeper coach mein 2 passengers ek seat share karte hain.
- Agar khaali seat milti hai to full confirm ho jaati hai.
- RAC wale ko train mein **chadhne** ki permission milti hai.

**Waitlist (WL):**
- Tab hota hai jab RAC bhi full ho jaaye.
- Chart banne tak WL number ghata confirm/RAC ho sakta hai.
- Agar chart banne tak confirm na ho to tick

tools.summary: RAC (Reservation Against Cancellation) ka matlab: seat share hoti hai, jaise khaali seat milti hai to full confirm. RAC ticket se sleeper coach mein do passenge
Waitlist (WL) ticket tab hota hai jab RAC bhi full ho. Chart banne tak WL number ghata confirm/RAC ho sakta hai; na ho to ticket cancel ho jaata hai aur refund
